_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/triggers/test_becomes_attached.py. t_ba_siona is Siona, Captain of the Pyleas's second line alone -- 'whenever an Aura you control becomes attached to a creature you control, create a 1/1 white Human Soldier creature token' -- so the test measures the trigger and not her enters ability. t_ba_hound is the host-side reading, 'whenever an Equipment becomes attached to this creature, draw a card', with no controller on the Equipment. t_ba_aura is a free vanilla Aura, t_ba_gear a vanilla Equipment with Equip {0}, and t_ba_bear a vanilla creature for them to go on.
